group_note: All six were read as the same printed shape - a single question with four bare answers, no lettered block and no list - and were judged against each other on three stated rules. (1) DEMAND: `recall` where one stored fact decides (q046, q047, q048, q050), `concept_discrimination` where the live decision is between neighbouring terms or categories rather than between a known and an unknown fact (q049 complete versus incomplete double circulation, q051 population/niche/community/ecosystem). That is the only reason two of the six differ on this axis. (2) STRUCTURE: `several_independent_checks` for the two negated questions whose four options are unrelated claims each needing its own verdict (q047, q048); `single_step` for the four where one fact or one definition settles it. Four option-checks are not four dependent steps, and nothing here feeds a later step. (3) TRAPS: the two negated questions carry the same device on every distractor - a true statement offered where the false one is asked for - so each is tagged `true_statement_trap` with the polarity named, and the uniformity is deliberate rather than mechanical: the questions are identical in construction. The definition questions (q049, q051) carry `other_one_fact` on each distractor that is the correct definition of a DIFFERENT member of the same family, with the member named every time; q049's option 1 and q051 have no untagged near-miss left over. Two members do not get tagged at all and this is the point of judging them together: 2015_A#q046 arrived damaged - its stem asks why root pressure "is usually acidic", which none of its four options addresses, and the same phrase is the stem of 2015_A#q091 in packet part8 - so it carries source_damage_artifact, empty traps and a repair note; 2015_A#q050's key is in doubt (detritivores is defensible for aphotic-zone fauna), so it carries arguable_key, the printed key is kept, and no route is written because a route can only be named once the answer is settled.
